answer: Each epoch the registry auctions only 200 identity slots; every bid locks POA in the vault until winners seal. Forging N identities means outbidding honest agents N times: the N-th puppet costs the N-th highest honest bid. Rejected bids echo back as refunds, while winners' deposits stay slashable if an audit proves them fake. Honest agents pay one clearing price; a thousand-puppet forge pays the top of the book, its ember of profit guttering out.
